message:
Hristina,

We're doing a small builder's dinner in SF next month with folks working on AI infrastructure and developer tools—Louan from UCSF and Artem from Osmosis AI are coming, plus a handful of other operators in the space. Your work on human-centered AI processes keeps coming to mind, especially around how tools need to respect the messier parts of research workflows rather than just optimize them away. Curious if you'd want to join.

Want in?
